finding: A successful status or mutable alias is insufficient to bind application code to a Vercel deployment. Acceptance requires the authenticated Vercel deployment object to expose a stable deployment id and generated hostname, READY state, project identity, and gitSource.sha equal to the exact tested GitHub commit.

sources.title: Get a deployment by ID or URL
Accessing Deployments through Generated URLs
sources.use: Distinguishes generated deployment URLs from project aliases and custom domains.

uncertainty: The Vercel API response shape may contain additional fields or account-specific omissions.
A READY deployment identity does not by itself prove route behavior, audio audibility, or production alias promotion.
falsification_route: Run the six deterministic Node tests.
Fetch an authenticated v13 deployment object for an exact commit.
Demonstrate rejection for mismatched gitSource.sha, non-READY state, deleted records, or absent deployment id.
Independently request the generated deployment hostname and retain response identity evidence.
